units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:2">B. Kam. I, 2</cite> <he>חבתי</he> … <he>כה׳ כל נזקו</he> I am bound to pay such compensation as though I had been the entire cause of the damage. Y. ib. 2ᵃ <he>לה׳ נזקין</he> it refers to responsibility for damage, opp. <he>נזקי גופו</he> infliction of bodily injuries; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:1:2">Y. Gitt. V, beg. 46ᶜ</cite>
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:1">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> <he>הֶכְשֵׁירוֹ באור</he> (an earthen or glass vessel) is finished in fire.

senses.gloss: that which makes a thing legal, that which is ritually fit (v. כָּשֵׁר).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:2:2">Y. Gitt. III, 44ᵈ</cite> <he>מפסולו את למד הכשירו</he> from what makes a letter of divorce invalid you can learn what makes it valid.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:3:5">Y. Pes. V, 32ᵇ</cite> top <he>לבור פסולו מתיך הכשירו</he> to distinguish the unfit element of it from the fit element.

senses.gloss: (levitical law) fitness to become unclean (which arises from contact with certain liquids), cause of fitness (הוכשר לקבל טומאה, v. כָּשֵׁר).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 36b:5">Ḥull. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>עשאוהו כה׳ מים</he> they declared it (slaughtering, pressing grapes) to be equal in its effect to the fitness for uncleanness which arises from contact with liquids.
<cite ref="Chullin 121a:19">Ib. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ מים ממקום אחר</he> the liquids which produce the fitness to become unclean must come from without.

<cite ref="Chullin 121a:19">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ למה לי</he> why should contact with liquids be necessary at all? <cite ref="Chullin 121a:19">Ib.</cite> <he>צריך ה׳</he> requires contact with liquids in order to become fit &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 7:6:2">Y. Kil. VII, end, 31ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 95b:1">Sabb. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ זרעים</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) the requirement that the plants (in the pot) must come in contact with liquids in order to be fit for uncleanness; a. fr.
